name_zh: 阿塞拜疆·海达尔阿利耶夫：石油转型与世俗伊斯兰
name_en: Azerbaijan Heydar Aliyev: Oil Transition & Secular Islam
description_zh: 海达尔·阿利耶夫 (1923-2003) 阿塞拜疆前总统 (1993-2003)，克格勃高官出身，独立后通过石油外交平衡俄土伊美，建立世俗化国家模式，奠定阿塞拜疆能源大国地位，家族政治延续至今。
description_en: Heydar Aliyev (1923-2003) Azerbaijan former President (1993-2003), KGB high official origin, post-independence balanced Russia Turkey Iran US through oil diplomacy, established secular state model, founded Azerbaijan energy power status, family politics continues today.
reason_zh: 阿利耶夫代表后苏联空间能源型威权转型的典范，展示了伊斯兰国家如何通过石油财富实现世俗化现代化，同时在大国博弈中维持战略自主。
reason_en: Aliyev represents post-Soviet energy authoritarian transition model, demonstrating how Islamic state achieves secular modernization through oil wealth while maintaining strategic autonomy in great power competition.
steps_zh: 研究阿利耶夫克格勃生涯与纳希切万自治共和国主席经历
分析1993年政变上台与纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫冻结冲突管理
探讨巴库-第比利斯-杰伊汉管道石油外交战略
评估世俗化宪法与伊斯兰传统平衡机制
总结阿利耶夫家族政治传承与伊利哈姆继任
steps_en: Study Aliyev KGB career and Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic Chairman experience
Analyze 1993 coup accession and Nagorno-Karabakh frozen conflict management
Explore Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan pipeline oil diplomacy strategy
Evaluate secular constitution and Islamic tradition balance mechanism
Summarize Aliyev family political succession and Ilham succession
expected_zh: 掌握阿利耶夫石油外交与世俗化转型双重策略，理解后苏联伊斯兰国家在大国博弈中的生存路径，评估其对里海能源地缘政治的深远影响。
expected_en: Master Aliyev oil diplomacy and secular transformation dual strategy, understand post-Soviet Islamic state survival path in great power competition, evaluate its profound impact on Caspian energy geopolitics.
case_zh: 1993 阿利耶夫政变上台；1994 巴库-第比利斯-杰伊汉管道签署；2003 伊利哈姆继任总统；阿塞拜疆成为欧盟关键能源供应国。石油世俗外交范式永存。
case_en: 1993 Aliyev coup accession; 1994 BTC pipeline signed; 2003 Ilham succeeded President; Azerbaijan became EU key energy supplier. Oil secular diplomacy paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Energy diplomacy model; secular Islamic state; family politics succession
